[EN] Stop the Murderwing Monarchs.
[ES] Detén a los Murderwing Monarchs.

[EN] Remove the barrier to defeat the Murderwing Monarchs.
[ES] Elimina la barrera para derrotar a los Murderwing Monarchs.

[EN] The barrier can be removed by collecting Blue Essence from Murderwings.
[ES] La barrera se puede eliminar recolectando Blue Essence de los Murderwings.

[EN] Wait for the Murderwing Monarchs to come to the ground when their barrier is removed.
[ES] Espera a que los Murderwing Monarchs bajen al suelo cuando su barrera sea eliminada.

[EN] The Red Essence will disturb flying. Be cautious.
[ES] La Red Essence perturbará el vuelo. Ten cuidado.
